review_cost.rationale: Approvable after one round: leak and cache fixes, deduping the species-map helpers, dropping the dead dependency, and adding basic unit tests.

findings.issue: Component-scoped streams use shareReplay({refCount: false}); after route destruction their source subscriptions (and emitted species/pokemon/version-group/move-table data) stay alive, accumulating one leak set per page visit.
findings.suggestion: Use refCount: true, rely on the ApiService cache for dedupe, or migrate reads to httpResource/resource which cancel and clean up automatically.

findings.issue: Failed GETs are cached forever: optional() treats any error as 'not found', so a single transient network error permanently renders that resource as Not found for the session.
findings.suggestion: Evict the cache entry when the request errors (e.g. tap({error}) deleting the key) or cache only successful responses.

findings.issue: The app declares 'ng test' and installs vitest/jsdom but contains zero test files; logic-heavy helpers (buildTables, compareRows, format.ts) are untested.
findings.suggestion: Add unit tests for table construction/sorting, the formatting helpers, and the home-page filter/pagination computations.

findings.issue: speciesById map and the alternate-forms (>10000) dedupe are rebuilt identically in move-page.ts, ability-page.ts:30 and type-page.ts:33, while CatalogService.catalog$ already exposes both.
findings.suggestion: Expose speciesById (and a card-view helper) from CatalogService and consume it in all three pages.

findings.issue: Hash scrolling is hand-rolled with effect + setTimeout keyed on window.location.hash, so it re-scrolls to #moves whenever tables change (e.g. after a sort click) and is skipped on server renders.
findings.suggestion: Enable withInMemoryScrolling({ anchorScrolling: 'enabled' }) on the router, or gate the effect to initial load only.

findings.issue: queryParamMap is cast via 'as unknown as Map<string, string>' to fit parseQuery; a type smell with no runtime safety.
findings.suggestion: Type parseQuery against ParamMap (which already has get) and drop the cast.

findings.issue: The undefined-vs-null sentinel (undefined = loading, null = resource missing) is implicit and repeated in every page template, easy to get wrong when editing.
findings.suggestion: Model load status explicitly (e.g. a 'status' computed with 'loading' | 'loaded' | 'notFound') or use a resource's error/hasValue state.

findings.issue: File naming mixes conventions: core keeps legacy .service.ts suffixes (api.service.ts, catalog.service.ts) while shared/ and pages/ use the suffixless v20+ style.
findings.suggestion: Pick one convention for the app; rename core services (api.ts/catalog.ts) or restore suffixes everywhere.

findings.issue: @angular/forms is declared as a dependency but no forms API is used anywhere (inputs/selects are bound with plain (input)/(change) handlers).
findings.suggestion: Remove the dependency, or use it if template bindings are intended to grow.

findings.issue: Runtime API base URL is injected as a window.__POKEDEX_API_BASE_URL__ global read deep inside ApiService, a hidden config channel.
findings.suggestion: Keep the injection but document it, or resolve the URL via an APP_INITIALIZER-provided InjectionToken so the dependency is declared.

summary: A clean, recognisably modern Angular 22 codebase that meets a demanding spec, with solid structure in CatalogService/ApiService and consistent signal-based patterns. The main merge blockers are per-navigation subscription leaks from refCount:false shareReplays, permanently cached failed requests, duplicated species-map logic across three pages, and the complete absence of unit tests. Approvable after one focused round of changes.
